home.companyDesc: Our students live wi th their teachers under a campus wi th a Japanlike environment . They intentionally use the Japanese language, pract ice the Japanese cul ture and even pract ice their skills under a Japanese system
home.proficientDesc: We screen our students well before accept ing them into our school. . Af ter properly orient ing the candidates who pass our screening process, we thoroughly interview them in order to judge their viabili ty for work in Japan
home.provenDesc: Our school operates under a system that makes our students st rive for excellence. We give our students monthly writ ten and oral exams, rewarding top students and penalizing underperforming students..
home.mannerDesc: Our students learn not only the Japanese language, but they also practice Japanese cul ture and manners such as proper “Aisatsu” and the importance of always being on time. Moreover, our students also get to develop their skills by undertaking skills t raining under a Japanese system.
home.passionateDesc: All of our teachers have worked in Japan for at least 3 years under the TITP and are JLPT (Minimum N3) and JFT Prometric passers. They t ruly love the company and it can be seen in the way they interact with students, clients and one another. Our teachers are empathet ic, honest and passionate, making them the Hashiras of Hashira.
home.well: WELL-KNOWN AS PEOPLE WHO WORK ABROAD
home.wellDesc: There are Filipinos all over the world from the United States to the Middle-East and Europe and all across Asia. Filipino workers have been known to be hard-working, bright , friendly and loyal to their employers.
home.englishDesc: Japan is moving towards Globalizat ion and the demand for the English language is growing across the count ry. Almost all Filipinos are proficient in English and are happy to share their
home.lowAgeDesc: The average age in the Philippines is around 25 years old, which means that there is a lot of youthful energy available for work in an aging Japan
home.lowWageDesc: The minimum wage in the Philippines is around 1,000yen/day. This has driven Filipinos to find employment in foreign countries, wi th Japan being the top choice for many Filipinos.
home.filipinoLoveDesc: Filipinos are t ruly enchanted by Japan and its people. We love to watch Anime, sing Karaoke and eat Ramen and Sushi. You probably won’t find a Filipino who doesn’t know what “Arigato” means! Japan is really the dream count ry of many Filipinos.

corporate.corporateDesc: Know all about one of the Philippines’ leading Japanese Schools
corporate.viceDesc: Nobuaki Kawamichi, Representative, RW Group. He has been involved in the foreign workforce recruitment business since he was 19 years old and participated in the launch of Business Supply Aichi Cooperative as a founding member. Since then, for over 20 years, he has been engaged in the recruitment of foreign workers, including through the Technical Intern Training Program. Currently, as Representative of the RW Group, he oversees foreign talent recruitment, Japanese language education, and various support services. Leveraging his many years of experience and his domestic and international networks, he supports both foreign workers and the companies that hire them. Through the training of foreign workers, Japanese language education, daily life support, and retention support, he is committed to fostering international talent exchange by serving as a bridge connecting Japan and the rest of the world.Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
corporate.presidentDesc: Joelo is a licensed attorney and a JLPT N1 passer. He obtained his degree in International Business from Pepperdine University and his Juris Doctor from Ateneo De Manila School of Law. He is also the President of Hashira Skills and Language Academy and Pro-Tech Skills Development Center Corporation. He has been with Placewell since 2018.
corporate.missionDesc: To create an inspiring learning environment for students where the Japanese language and culture are practiced daily, leading to their personal development, growth and future success. We hope that the success of our students will lead to more opportunities for Filipinos to work in Japan.
corporate.visionDesc: To make the Filipino the top choice for Japanese companies that need foreign labor. We aim to make our institution one of the prime spots for Filipinos who are looking to find work in Japan.
corporate.ourDesc: We promise that the students that you hire from our school will be ready for work in Japan. They will flourish as workers and be liked as people because of their knowledge of the Japanese Language and respect for the Japanese Cul ture. We assure you that your Filipino workers will be a great help to you and your company.
corporate.ourStudentDesc: We promise that you will not only gain new and useful knowledge about the Japanese language and cul ture, but you will also grow as people during your t ime wi th us. We will serve you wi th all our hear t because i t will be our pleasure to see you fulfill your dreams and succeed in Japan.
corporate.messageDesc: My name is Jose Lorenzo Escueta Beech, but you can call me Joelo! While studying in Japan as an exchange student, I learned a lot of things about the Japanese culture that we don’t practice consistently in the Philippines. These include: Compassion, Courtesy, Humility, Trust and Responsibility - practices that are natural to Japanese people, but may not be to my Filipino countrymen and myself. For this reason, I established Hashira Skills with the goal of spreading the Japanese Language and Culture throughout the Philippines so that more Filipinos can find work and succeed in Japan. I love the students who have trusted their future in our school. I love my teachers who have dedicated themselves to growing and improving our company. And I am so thankful to all of the companies who have given this wonderful, life-changing opportunity to all of our students and team members. Our company values the connection that we have developed with both companies and students alike, as we build a cross-culture bridge between two nations that need each other’s help. Hashira hopes to continue helping hundreds of Filipinos make their dreams come true as we strive to develop young and diligent workers who will surely be a great help to a Japan that is aging and in need of competent foreign workforce. Hashira Skills is always at your service!

whatIsHashira.subtitle: What is Hashira?

whatIsHashira.hashiraDesc: Hashira Skills is a skills and language institution that was established to help young Filipinos achieve their dream of working in Japan. Students live with their teachers in a Japan-like environment where we teach not only the Japanese language but also Japanese culture and manners. Employers can interview candidates who already speak Japanese because we only recommend students for interview if they perform well at school. Hashira Skills prides itself in being an institution that is run by Filipinos who understand the heart of the Japanese.

overall.title: System
overall.subtitle: Overall
overall.desc: Our system ensures that we provide our clients with the best possible Filipino Workers
overall.OrientationDesc: We start by hosting an information session for interested candidates where we explain the whole process from point A to Z.
overall.ScreeningDesc: Candidates who are interested in our program are pre-interviewed and screened through IQ, math, and personality tests and more.
overall.StudyDesc: Employers can interview candidates who already speak Japanese because we only recommend students for interview if they perform well at school.
overall.InterviewDesc: We are able to facilitate orderly and efficient interviews and trade tests through our experienced staff.
overall.MonthlyDesc: Our students are required to take a monthly evaluation. Those who fail are either kicked out or re-batched.
overall.PostDesc: Although it is mainly the responsibility of the agency to monitor our workers in Japan, we take responsibility in ensuring the welfare of our students in Japan because we treasure the relationship we built with them while they studied at our school.

specialRules.title: System
specialRules.subtitle: Special Rules
specialRules.desc: We implement these rules to encourage a disciplined and competitive environment
specialRules.JapaneseDesc: We encourage our students to speak Japanese as much as possible while inside the school.
specialRules.StrikeDesc: Students who break rules and consistently perform poorly in class may be subjected to warnings or even dismissal from the school.
specialRules.MockDesc: Our students are required to take multiple JFT mock tests before taking the actual exam. Our mock tests consist of compilations of past JFT questions.
specialRules.WeekendDesc: Students are allowed to go home for the weekend if their cumulative average for the said week is above 70%.
specialRules.RebatchingDesc: We give chances to failing students who have a good attitude and work hard. Instead of kicking them out, we transfer them to a lower batch in hopes they give an improved performance.

construction.title: Skills Training
construction.subtitle: Construction
construction.desc: See how we train our construction workers
construction.WeldingDesc: Learn the fundamental knowledge, safety procedures, and practical skills required for welding work. Our training prepares students for manufacturing and construction workplaces in Japan.
construction.CarpentryDesc: Students learn basic construction techniques, tool handling, and workplace safety to develop the skills needed in Japan's building industry.
construction.ScaffoldingDesc: Training focuses on scaffolding assembly, dismantling procedures, safety awareness, and teamwork required on Japanese construction sites.
construction.MasonryDesc: Students learn the fundamentals of plastering work, including material handling, finishing techniques, and quality control standards.
construction.PaintingDesc: Our painting program covers surface preparation, painting techniques, and safety practices to help students succeed in Japanese workplaces.
construction.SafetyDesc: We believe that safety is the foundation of every successful worker. Through continuous guidance and practical training, we instill strong safety awareness and responsible workplace behavior in our students.
construction.TechnicalDesc: Effective communication begins with understanding the language of the workplace. We provide industry-specific terminology training to help students communicate confidently and accurately in Japan.
construction.EmphasisDesc: Understanding instructions correctly is essential for success in the workplace. Our training focuses on developing listening, comprehension, and response skills needed in Japanese working environments.

hospitality.title: Skills Training
hospitality.subtitle: Hospitality
hospitality.desc: Enhancing the heart of the Filipino
hospitality.CaregivingDesc: Our caregiving training facility is designed to simulate a modern Japanese nursing care environment. Students develop practical skills, professional knowledge, and the mindset required to provide compassionate care in Japan.
hospitality.FoodDesc: Students receive hands-on training in food preparation, customer service, hygiene management, and workplace communication to meet the standards of Japan's food service industry.
hospitality.HousekeepingDesc: Our training environment replicates hotel and residential settings, allowing students to develop cleaning, organization, and hospitality skills required in Japan.
hospitality.JapaneseDesc: We teach the spirit of Japanese hospitality, emphasizing attentiveness, respect, and consideration for others. Students learn how to provide service that exceeds expectations.
hospitality.TechnicalDesc: Students learn the professional language and expressions commonly used in customer-facing roles, helping them communicate politely and confidently in Japanese workplaces.

japaneseCulture.title: System
japaneseCulture.subtitle: Japanese Culture and Manners
japaneseCulture.desc: Just as important as Japanese language
japaneseCulture.item1Desc: Learn about Japanese culture, daily customs, workplace etiquette, and rules to help you adapt smoothly to life and work in Japan.
japaneseCulture.item2Desc: Develop the habit of proper greetings, an important part of Japanese society, and build communication skills that create a positive impression.
japaneseCulture.item3Desc: Through dormitory living designed to simulate communal life in Japan, students develop discipline, teamwork, cleanliness, and a sense of responsibility.
japaneseCulture.item4Desc: Learn proper waste separation methods and recycling rules that are essential to daily life in Japan while developing greater environmental awareness.
japaneseCulture.item5Desc: Former technical interns with work experience in Japan provide practical advice and guidance based on their own experiences.

slide2.title1: Features of Hashira Japanese Language School
slide2.Through: Through Japanese language instruction, specialized education, and life guidance,
slide2.we: We are developing talent capable of excelling in Japanese companies.
slide2.item1desc: You’ll learn the Japanese language needed for daily life and work in Japan in a practical way.
slide2.item2: A time and space spent exclusively in Japanese
slide2.item2desc: We do not limit ourselves to classroom settings and encourage conversation in Japanese to foster natural communication skills.
slide2.item3desc: You will learn the specialized skills and foundational knowledge required for various occupations, such as construction, nursing care, the restaurant industry, and agriculture.
slide2.item4desc: You will learn the safety awareness and rules required in Japanese workplaces and acquire the fundamentals for working safely.
slide2.item5desc: From life guidance to career support, we provide attentive support to each and every individual.
slide2.item6: High Pass Rate and Employment Track Record
slide2.item6desc: We offer test preparation for the JFT-Basic and PROMETRIC exams, and many students have successfully secured employment in Japan.

whatIsHashiraItem.item1Desc: Learn comprehensively about Japanese culture and customs, daily life etiquette in Japan, seasonal events, and traditional culture to deepen your understanding of Japanese society.
whatIsHashiraItem.item2Desc: Learn practical Japanese communication skills for daily and workplace conversations, including honorifics, reporting, contacting, consulting, and customer service expressions.
whatIsHashiraItem.item3Desc: Understand Japanese ways of thinking and values while learning practical workplace attitudes, sense of responsibility, cooperation, courtesy, and time awareness.
whatIsHashiraItem.item4Desc: Through pre-interview training, students develop basic Japanese language skills before the interview and gain the confidence to participate in company interviews in Japanese.
whatIsHashiraItem.item5Desc: Our staff help students understand the mindset and way of thinking of Japanese people while providing guidance that addresses the concerns and challenges faced by Filipino students.
whatIsHashiraItem.item6Desc: Students live together in an environment that simulates life in Japan, allowing them to practically learn Japanese lifestyles, culture, and etiquette while developing the skills needed to adapt smoothly to life in Japan.

schoolInformation.title: About Us
schoolInformation.subtitle: School Information
schoolInformation.desc: Take a look at our school facilities
schoolInformation.video: Introduction Video of Hashira Japanese Language School
schoolInformation.section3Subtitle: We support your first step toward success in Japan with an environment designed for both comfortable learning and living.
schoolInformation.item1Desc: Every morning, all students participate in exercises and a morning assembly to start the day with energy and enthusiasm.
schoolInformation.item2Desc: The cafeteria provides nutritionally balanced meals, while students become accustomed to life in Japan through practicing meals using chopsticks.
schoolInformation.item3Desc: Our TESDA-certified welding practice area allows candidates' practical skills to be assessed on-site, making it possible to evaluate their technical abilities during interviews.
schoolInformation.item4Desc: Bright and comfortable classrooms provide an environment where students can focus on learning Japanese and developing specialized knowledge.
schoolInformation.item5Desc: Experienced instructors are always available to provide support and guidance regarding students' learning and daily life.
schoolInformation.item6Desc: Equipped with a stable internet connection, the interview room accommodates both online and face-to-face interviews.
schoolInformation.item7Desc: Our full-dormitory environment allows students to live safely and securely while focusing on their studies. Through communal living, students also develop the lifestyle habits and teamwork skills needed in Japan.
schoolInformation.item8Desc: By doing their own laundry every day, students develop independence and essential life skills.

groupCompany.title: Company Introduction
groupCompany.subtitle: Introduction to Our Group Companies
groupCompany.desc: An introduction to our group companies
groupCompany.item1Desc: Placewell International is a Filipino-owned, family-run manpower agency that has been sending Filipino workers overseas for more than 50 years. Headquartered in Makati, the company works with more than 15 branches nationwide to recruit, train, and deploy Filipino talent to companies around the world. Placewell is committed to providing reliable talent and efficient, organized, and responsive services, while also creating opportunities for professional growth by connecting Filipino workers with companies that recognize and value their contributions.
groupCompany.item2Desc: Business Supply Aichi Cooperative has been a trusted partner of Hashira Skills since its establishment in 2019. As an authorized supervising organization in Japan, the cooperative has been involved in receiving and supporting Filipino talent for more than 20 years, building extensive experience and a strong track record. Its operations extend across Japan, with offices in Aichi, Tokyo, Kansai, Hokkaido, Kyushu, and Okinawa, connecting companies in each region with foreign talent.
